notes.title: New Ghostship Chronicles update available!
notes.content:
[h1]Ghostship Chronicles v1.2 is now available.[/h1] (6gb)

Following on from the improvements in the 1.1 update last year, 1.2 is a quality update that replaces a lot of the old enemies and AI and introduces the new ones which are more in line with the original 2 games.

[h2]All new infected and aliens[/h2]

In our last update, the aliens were changed and had many problems and bugs.  We have gone back to the more evolved original style alines which are much better suited as well as all-new infected enemies.  The game now gets harder as the storyline progresses.


[h2]AI Improvements [/h2]

Improved AI for teammates and enemies.  The enemy has had more rebalancing to make the game easier at the start and get harder as you progress through the game.  Teammates should be much better now when you have them.


[h2]Improved VFX and weapon animations [/h2]

Improvements with visual effects and weapon animations make the gameplay feel much better.  Lean has now been removed (e - is now default to interact/pickup) 



[h2]Improved UI  [/h2]

Improved Inventory UI so all resolution types work as intended.  perks have also been removed as they no longer serve a purpose.



[h2]MULTIPLAYER CO-OP BETA[/h2]

Multiplayer team deathmatch is now being worked on and is currently not available in the new update.  Focus has always been on single-player and multi-player will come back soon for more beta testing.

notes.title: Update 1.1 released
notes.content:
[h2]Ghostship Chronicles - Version 1.1 update is now available![/h2]

[h1]What has changed?[/h1]

[h3]Story mode improvements[/h3]

New story additions and parts of the ship to explore, as well as difficulty levels.  A new map tool has now been added as well as a bunch of other improvements to cinematics, VFX, sound and animation.  Lots of new effects and more content has been added to help build a much more atmospheric game. 


[h3]AI Improvements [/h3]

Improved AI, zombies, animations, more enemies, better SFX, new enemies, and much more.


[h3]Improved VFX and weapons [/h3]

Laser rifles are much better, with new sounds, new FX, and better balancing.  All weapons have been improved and re-balanced along with improved sound and visuals. 


[h3]Document/Logs overhaul[/h3]

Documents are now picked up and can be read in inventory while the game is paused.  These logs can be read at any time by hovering over the log in the inventory menu.


[h3]Improved UI and new menu background [/h3]

With recent improvements to the inventory menu such as item stacking, hover over info and weapons info the main menu has also Improved with a patch notes button and a new menu background which is much more appropriate than the previous background.


[h3]New Map Tool[/h3]

An all-new and essential nav tool in Normal and Hard modes introduces the map Tool.  Use this to navigate, On easy, a nav marker and distance are still relevant.


[h3]More Achievements[/h3]

More achievements have been added as more has been added to the game and difficulty level achievements.  

[h3]Misc Improvements and fixes[/h3]

A host of fixes and improvements have been implemented in many aspects of the game and game-play.  



[h3]MULTIPLAYER CO-OP BETA[/h3]

Multiplayer team deathmatch is now replaced with a survival Co-op story 4 player beta.  Following the story of the echo squad based on the ship prior to the Delta squad's arrival, you must work with friends, or really hard as a lone hero to survive the new story.  The first beta may have some issues! These will be ironed out in coming updates as co-op survival mode gets fixed up and expanded.  This will still be in beta for the rest of 2021.

notes.title: New Update (V1.0.5) is now available. Features new content and improvements
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0.5 is now online (2gb) and has lots of new content and a host of improvements and fixes.[/h3]


[h2]Inventory Improvements[/h2]

The inventory has gone through some major improvements to make it easier and quicker as well as more informative. The items now stack, and give you a number for that item. Before the items were placed in individual slots and would litter the inventory and make it very difficult to count a specific item in inventory. The I button has now been removed and items now display information when hovered over the slot. This has also been applied to weapons which all now have descriptions.

[h2]ATV - Buggy Improvements[/h2]

The ATV has had much more work on mechanics which makes it feel much better in the game and handles much better on the terrain. The vehicle eject has also been fixed up where previously the player would be ejected from the world.

[h2]New Content[/h2]

As a random element, the first 2 starting chapters have a new story which will make it more interesting and fun especially for those who have played the game. This is the starting base for more random story branches with new areas of the ship in the next update.

[h2]Overhauled the pick-up / Interact[/h2]

Previously only a hand icon was visible when you could interact with items, lockers, doors, and consoles. As a lot of people were unsure of the controls this has been improved. Using gamepad or keyboard and mouse item interactions have been improved which tells the player which key to press.
This improves the flow of the game, especially for new players.


[h2]Remastered Infected Crew[/h2]

The infected crew - Zombies have a had many improvements in animation and now look much better.  We have slowed some of them down and given you more to deal with.  The zombie AI has had some improvements and will now improve the feel of the game as these are the first enemy you encounter.

[h2]Hit effects Improvements[/h2]

The flashing green screen when hit by an enemy has now gone and has been replaced with a more relevant effect when having armour or not.  When hit with armour you will get a gentle blue tinge depending on the amount of armour damage.  

[h2]More Challenging Gameplay[/h2]

The new random story start is more challenging than the original in some ways.  Some enemies take a little more damage and some are now slower as wer balance out the gameplay and fun factor

[h2]Other Improvements and Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Ending is now also working with some new cinematics.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would get stuck in Maintenance - Story Mode
[*] Fixed misc typos
[*] Fixed bug in ASMI cutscene where the player could throw grenades switch weapons etc.
[*] Fixed a bug in Third person Advanced Rifle (Green floating orb has now gone)
[*] Fixed up an issue where the end of the level would not trigger when clearing out the Yellani base.
[*] Fixed Lean not working
[*] Fixed Monster Mash Achievement not working
[*] Fixed F as interacting/use a pickup, not as default (previously T)
[*] Team AI improvements
[*] Misc fixes and improvements
[/list]

These fixes and improvements help the gameplay and feel of the game. Thanks for the feedback everyone.
Have fun with the new update, in our next update, we will be adding more story mode content and replacing Team death match with a survival co-op mode. Thanks for playing.

[h2]Thanks for supporting Indie Games [/h2]

www.MadAboutGamesStudios.com

notes.title: First Patch of 2021 is now available (1.0.3)
notes.content:
[h2]We all took a step back in 2020.  In 2021, we move forward with hope and enthusiasm and our first update of 2021 for Ghostship Chronicles.[/h2]

[h2][b]Patch Notes V1.0.3[/b][/h2]
__________________


[h3]Tutorial[/h3]   The tutorial has been worked on and expanded upon.  The tutorial is now much easier and more fun to play.  The game now requires you to have completed the tutorial which now emphasizes the main aspects of some crucial gameplay elements much better.  [/h3]

[h3]New additional content[/h3]   There is an all-new and much more relevant single player onslaught map - Yellani station!  Battle a new enemy with lots more fun in a more practical and relevant scenario for an onslaught mode map.  There is also a host of new infected which was tried and tested during beta testing which is now in story mode and onslaught maps.

[h3]Gameplay Quality[/h3]  As an indie game with a lot of unique features and a shoestring budget.  This game will receive regular patches and updates over the coming months.  In this latest update, the balance and quality of the game have had some major improvements over the last few updates in 2020.  We have a fun and extensive game that works great with single-player and over the coming updates we will be extending and fixing up the current multiplayer build.  As an honest developer, don`t get this game at this time for multiplayer.  In the months ahead, we will be moving forward and get enough testers to release some cool new multiplayer-focused content.

[h3]Performance Optimisations[/h3]  We have made many optimizations in the game in general and everyone will get much better FPS rates.  For ATI based players, there are common Unreal engine Game problems with spikes and irregular gameplay drops. This is something we will always do what we can, but for this release, ATI users should get much better performance than before as well as fewer or no crashes. Feedback from the ATI community is vital to work on this more in the coming updates.

[h3]Improved lighting[/h3]   The start of the story mode is very dark, some maps are also very dark.  With improved scopes (Aiming) there is now much better visibility and some sights see through fog such as the SMG Image Intensification sight.  While others such as the battle rifle have a thermal scope with a friend or foe tagging system.   The standard assault rifle now has a new sight that eliminates dark areas and highlights pickups and items of interest.  Aside from the weapon lighting improvements the flares are now working great and give off much more light.  Some decks now have emergency lighting which will help light the area around you while keeping the atmosphere of the game.

[h3]AI Improved[/h3]   Improved teammate AI and also reduced damage from enemy attacks.  They should now help much more and help players got to further chapters with a surviving teammate.
Enemy AI is now much better, with bug fixes, and more varied and new enemies which really help the look and feel of the game as well as huge gameplay and experience for new and current players of the game.

[h3]Improved multiplayer[/h3]   We have made some major improvements for multi-player such as removing the aliens, improving the weapons and sights, and making the 4 available team death match maps more fun.  As not many people have the game it is best to arrange to play with a friend or group of others who have the game.  Coming updates will see much more added to multiplayer including co-op survival mode. 

[h3]Story Mode Random elements and Balancing[/h3]   Story mode has now been much better balanced and easier progression curve as you get through the chapters.  With the new extra additional chapters, the player needs to survive with at least 1 teammate.  This should now be much easier and will make you work more as you get through the story.   Each new game will seem that little different with new additional random elements for encounters and flow of the game.  This will be expanded on much more in our next update.



[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
__________________________


[h3]In our new update, many issues, bugs and some weird things happening for some of you in single-player have been fixed up.  Multiplayer is still being worked up for coming updates.[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Fixes some muzzle flash effects on laser rifle mk5 and the Advanced assault rifle.
[*] Fixed a bug where Friend or for tracker would keep some zombies and other enemies highlighted after death.
[*] Improved all AI smoothness for animation.
[*] Fixed multiple bugs for most enemy AI which animation for hit and attack did not activate.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where some gas-masked zombies would spawn blood in the air with collision - which in turn affected player movement.
[*] Zombie navigation improvements.
[*] Zombie animation and bone improvements for better close up effects.
[*] New enemies added ( A new and official enemy update guide will be released for the community on the 18th of January 2021.
[*] Fixed up issues with the player collision in stasis on story mode.
[*] Added more items in story mode.
[*] Teammate AI damage reduced, collision improved, and additional teammate inclusion in the tutorial.
[*] Improved the flow and balancing of story mode to make the progression curve much better.
[*] Icharids now jump as well as some other enemies.
[*] More voice acting added.
[*] UI improvements and main menu enhancements for Onslaught mode.
[*] Performance optimizations for AI and in-game effects.
[*] Lots of misc. bug fixes, this is a major update.
[*] Multiplayer fixes and improvements
[/list][/b]

[h2][h3]Additional Notes and Tips :[/h3][/h2]

ATI users are best using Vulkan!  Our game supports it and will really help with fps and other issues.


There is a setup launch option that gives everyone the ability to customize all the controls such as movement and on different keyboard types.  Be sure to check out the config utility which is a launch option on steam before starting the game.  Thanks go out to our Number 1 and everyone in the world who is keeping you safe so you can play our awesome 1st update of 2021.  As we move forward, let us know how things are improving or not.

MAG Studios Team

All the best for 2021 and we look forward to seeing videos of how the game plays out for you.

notes.title: A New Year update is now available!
notes.content:
[b]We finish 2020 with a second major update  - V1.0.2.1 - (1.9gb) which really adds a better feel and quality boost to the game.  In the last major update we introduced extra content and more improvements.  This update follows on with some major improvements to some core parts of the game such as aiming down sights, weapons, Zombies, special effects and much more.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/cdc7137aaceba84776c235e3feabb958e46405e5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Change-log since V1.0.
-------------------------[/h2]

Improved weapons and usability!  Most weapons have had a number of improvements.   The new Vision X holo-sight for the standard rifle now illuminates dark areas and highlights pickups.  Other weapons such as Battle rifle and mini-gun now have new sights with Friend or Foe systems to highlight hostile targets. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/5fc345a7f5c732388ee0bf2ccbe2664ef8613c7b.jpg[/img]

Zombie improvements!  Less buggy, more varieties, improved animation and AI and much better Zombies with better headshot effects and new blood effects.

Team Mate Boost - Team mates are now much better and keeping at least some alive should be much easier.  Better AI, can take more damage and generally fight much better.

Better performance!  We have made more optimisations to make the game run much better.  You will still need to observe minimum specs and if using a laptop - Use low Effects settings.

More random elements added to story line so no 2 games will be exactly the same.  Story mode is much more fun and still full of surprises after this update.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/ed32d839d167c86fb03f474684f8c1c3703e0f30.jpg[/img]

Lots more improvements and bug fixes.

[h3]We wish you all the best for 2021 and look forward to bringing co-op survival to our next major update in 2021.  Keep safe everyone and have fun with the update.


Don`t forget to sign up on the official forums for all the latest news and to meet other for Multiplayer gaming!  http://www.MadAboutGamesStudios.com[/h3]


The Dev will be showing off some of these features in a live steam broadcast at 9.30 PM GMT-0  (UK Time)   Be sure to check it out and have a great new year everyone

notes.title: Winter 2020 Content update now available
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,  a huge content update is now available  (3.4gb) download and the game size has now been extended to 36gb.[/h2]

The new update is huge and offers many hours of fun and extends story mode with lots of extra fun and objectives as you try and survive on the planet.  If you have at least one survivor you can play through the extra chapters.  If you survive alone then the game will end there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/ea570e2224ad1734c0d3924afa8366b788856efd.jpg[/img]

We have made it easier to keep team mates alive, improved team mate AI and improved enemy AI.  There are lots more goodies for you such as more medical boxes to keep your team alive.

There are lots of improvements and more lighting has been added to the first chapter on story mode.  There are also some team death match improvements.

As we look forward into early 2021 we will be introducing the Co-Op survival mode as well as more voice acting, cinematics and content for Story mode and Onslaught modes.

Have a great festive season everyone and I hope 2021 works out better for us all.

[h2]It has now been 2 weeks since release and we have released 4 small update patches in the last 2 weeks.  With the improvements to Team AI and enemies a host of other issues have been fixed up. [/h2]

[h3]Update V1.0.1.5 is now available (2.1gb)  [/h3]

The new update has a host of improvements and adds some new content.

[b]What has changed since the last update?[/b]

New and improved Zombies which offer more variety and have some more improvements for physics and facial animations.  The zombie AI has also been improved and now act much better and die much better.  There are better head-shot effects and the crawlers act and look much better.

Gameplay hints are now in story mode to explain a few crucial things such as healing team mates and not shooting the eggs.  Judging from a lot of gameplay videos a lot of players had issues with these and it is obvious that many did not play the tutorial.  Eggs have a much lesser chance of spawning a hatchling when destroyed and team AI will no longer walk into eggs.

The tutorial now needs to be completed, if not every time the game starts - it will load the tutorial.  The tutorial can be quit and the game can be played as normal but this is more to push players to playing through the tutorial and understanding the game better.

A lot more optimisations have been done to the latest build which will make the game run much better overall.  There have also been some changes which may help people with a rare dx9 crash bug which some have reported.     For best results use a low effects settings on lower end system as this makes a huge difference to frame rate.


More improvements have been made to the small arms training simulator (SATS).  Targets know have a knockdown effect when you shoot them.  New and improved zombies and bigger hordes are now in the simulator.


Some more random battles have been added and some pre-work for the extra content update we will be releasing in a couple of weeks time.


In general the game should feel and run much better with the new improvements and extra content.

notes.title: Ghostship Chronicles is coming to Steam on the 17th November 2020!
notes.content:
We have just over a week to go until Ghostship Chronicles releases here on steam.   We will be releasing our game-play and cinematic release trailer next week so stay tuned for more.  Our Ghostship Chronicles steam store page has been updated with current and relevant screenshots from the release version and our 2 final release trailers will be added next week.  These can also be found on the official web site.

[h1]Official Teaser Trailer can be found here - [/h1]

[previewyoutube=H8cFoqH4Iss;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/f042bbec35c5b1bd7ebb32cc0385ae5244425971.png[/img]

MAG studios original web site and e-mails have been lost due to a dispute with our previous long time service provider who will not be named at this time.  A new and relevant web site and domain is now online and can be found at - www.MadAboutGamesStudios.com.  We have had some e-mail issues and  our emails have been suspended for the last week.  We are sorry if you could not get in touch, these issues have been fixed and our e-mails are now working.

[h2]Our all new Official MAG Studios web site and domain :[/h2]

[url=http://www.MadAboutGamesStudios.com]www.MadAboutGamesStudios.com[/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/a5ae4bbad49fe4ec5efbaa50fff6241d51831a41.png[/img]

We will be working on promotion over the next 10 days so if you need a press copy for review, then feel free to get in touch with your details.  All contact information is on the new MAG web site so please get in touch via the correct channels now our e-mail is working.  The next week will also be spent improving any remaining issues to make sure everyone has the same experience with some random and game-play directed elements.  We want this game to play and feel as good as it looks with enough to keep you coming back for more, and then there is multiplayer with a team death match game mode which offers a lots more fun with aliens in the mix a difference.  Try and score point for your team while fending off those nasties.

[h1]Ghostship Chronicles Release Info
-------------------------------------[/h1]

Most feedback from the original 2 Ghostship games have been taken into account as well as a much longer alpha and beta testing period.   Ghostship 3 has been developed over the last 4 and a half years using the Unreal 4 engine, the first 2 Ghostship games (Ghostship Aftermath & CDF Ghostship)  where both developed in UDK (unreal 3).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/5e21a4402ea1e59fdf291ca2656524230aae7b5c.png[/img]

Ghostship chronicles features a host of game-play improvements, visuals and much better inventory system and items you can pick up and make use of. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/e197ae89a7b2d0b8e166c2f94b810d55a5aa39ec.png[/img]

Team Ai is a big part of the game offering different stories and endings as team mates survive during the game in story mode.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/b2963fce4755ad16cf74a9a40196612a415b61b9.png[/img]

The game fully supports game-pad and has many control optimisation features and settings.  A configuration tool is also included to set up controls and other aspects of the game before launch.

The game has 45 achievements to give you a challenge and a degree of fun.  Onslaught mode also has achievements which is a wave based instant action mode.  On the surface there may not look that much to this indie title, but dig a little deeper and there is much more to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/3523f494453f2112ddfe2f14bae9f32a46927d69.png[/img]

While not essential we strongly advise playing through the tutorial to get a good understanding of the game and its features.  Then try out the weapons training simulator (Firing range) to get used to weapons and items you will find in the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/3534fc4a37784cc2a8e29fe06be89862cdba4e0d.png[/img]

We will be bringing more updates this coming week with more features of the game and some game-play.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/76d637e320deffbf70b192e1380afa42279f963f.png[/img]

Thanks to the small team and all of our supporters throughout the years for your patience and feedback and support.  We hope Ghostship 3 was worth the wait and appeals to many more space marines.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/b49fbcf1b67c9ca96ddad37926ff15bc6493cd14.png[/img]

[h1]Ghostship Nostalgia[/h1]


The original concept and alpha for the orignal Ghostship Aftermath game launched in 2014 was in development almost a decade ago.  Here is an original game and gameplay-play video concept from 2011 - 

[previewyoutube=vIsd2n9LH6Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Beta 0.95.2 released for beta testing
notes.content:
Happy 2020 everyone!  We have had a lot of updates since 0.9.4.0 which add more content and improvements to the game based of our beta testing feedback on discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/e001bdf0240df7c107430e7eb652830c37374a56.jpg[/img]

**IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR BETA TESTERS AT THE END OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT!**

[h1][b]Changes since beta 0.9.4.0
-----------------------------[/b]
[/h1]

[h2]Updated the Unreal engine version from 4.20 to 4.23[/h2]

The engine and base code has been updated to use a newer build of the engine which has numerous benefits.  There is some small performance increases as well as broader sdk support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/17c142901a7271db26c7c4081ff95f08ae4720b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved Effects and Sounds[/h2]

There have been many improvements and new effects added to bolster the game atmosphere and environment.  There are new sounds, voice acting and music in the new build to raise the quality of the game in general.   There are new weapon effects and lighting has had a full makeover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/58cd47c8bfca917eba86b0734bd962b19f34111e.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Content[/h2]

There are a number of new maps for instant action which now offers more diversity and gameplay.   New maps include Bug Bash, scavenger and the baby sitter challenge.  There are also new items which can be used such as energy shields, land mines, flares, grenades and boxes of kit such as grenades and stims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/435a824800913605e3e2f3b9a36fff297d369461.jpg[/img]

[h2]Weapon And Difficulty Balancing[/h2]

There has been much work done on balancing for each map on each difficulty level.  There have been fixes to bugs such as being able to shoot an enemy at point black range.  Enemies have also had hit point changes and zombies are now easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/10b17b3a9dfd363478afe5f79ecf930d6a211afa.jpg[/img]


[h2]Game-play improvements[/h2]

There has been a lot work done across the board to improve on the game and player experience.    Enemy and friendly AI has been worked on as well as weapons and inventory.  There are numerous small changes and fixed throughout the game which helps bolster the game atmosphere and the fun and replay factor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/c52895207cce19947e9b36acabbbb549429d928f.jpg[/img]


All in all, #tThere have been a lot improvements and huge thanks go out to our testers who have helped shaped the new beta.  

[previewyoutube=cRGFYZKuv10;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]**IMPORTANT - FOR BETA TESTERS**[/h3]

Since we have had a major engine change, you will need to delete the games old .ini files in order for you to have a problem free experience.  The Current ones will be based on the old engine and you will need to manually delete these files before starting the new update.
to do this :

Go to your user folder in windows, make sure "show hidden files and folders" is enabled! This can be done by :


Windows 7

1) Select the Start button, then select Control Panel > Appearance and Personalization.
2) Select Folder Options, then select the View tab.
3)Under Advanced settings, select Show hidden files, folders, and drives, and then select OK.

Windows 8 & 10

1) Navigate to the control panel. ...
2) Select Large or Small icons from the View by menu if one of them is not already selected.
3) Select File Explorer Options (sometimes called Folder options)
4) Open the View tab.

Delete the folder "GSChronicles" located in the Users/Appdata/Local/

Eg : C:Users******AppDataLocalGSChronicles

This folder was created with an old build and needs to be deleted in order for the new controls and features to initialise. This folder is separate from game install, so unless this folder is deleted for people with an old build, you will run into problems. please note that anyone who gets and installs the game after this announcement will not need to perform this action.

notes.title: Beta 0.9.4.0 Released for beta testing
notes.content:
We have had a lot of updates since 0.9.3.1 which add more content and improvements based of our beta testing feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/26375e236220226ad6ba3d775daf32a9f2b11da3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Optional Health Bars[/h1]

The player can now have optional health bars on enemy and or friendlies.  This can be useful to quickly locate enemies and prioritise fire between them.  It can also help with friendly AI to see how much health your team mates have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/d42f63708ffc0634b8bff92d66cb57cb1d12d0d1.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Inventory Items and Uses[/h1]

More inventory items have been added such as grenade boxes which will replenish your grenade supply, Stim boxes which will replenish your stim supply and Shotgun shell boxes which can carry 24 shells and uses up only 1 inventory space.  Medical supplies can now also be used to heal your team mates.  More items have been added and the inventory has had more improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/020cf34edee2e8dbfb58310354f1c0b52ae3bf9d.jpg[/img]

[h1]3rd Person Improvements[/h1]

There have been a number of improvements to the third player view.  The player camera follows the character much smoother and has better collision reaction.  A camera swap is now also available (double tap – Switch camera view) when in third person to swap between right and left.  This gives the player a better scope for viewing enemies and combat and navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/16f0fbda9742d743ed7cf05218a97f5e5cb97709.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weapon Improvements[/h1]

Weapons have had improvements for balancing and making each weapon more unique and fit its role much better.  The Prototype rifle II sight has had vast improvements along with all other weapons.  Tactical lights have had a revamp and are much more effective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/d618ed1f22aa9e53064f98197c69c639488c2fca.jpg[/img]

[h1]Better Performance[/h1]

Many parts of the game have been optimised for better performance and the game now also supports Open GL along with Vulcan.  As well as performance increases over previous builds the game now also has real-time FOV slider and other options to play the game you want to play it.

[h1]Difficulty Balancing[/h1]

A lot of work over the last 2 months has been done on Difficulty balancing in each of the tree categories (easy, normal and Hard.)  Each category has been tested and tweaked with 10 updated over the last month.  Each difficulty makes a big impact on the gameplay and experience.

[h1]Achievements [/h1]

All 28 Instant action achievements are now included in this beta.  More will follow in further updates along with the story mode achievements.

[h1]New Challenges[/h1]

2 New challenges are now available – Scavenger and Babysitter.  These 2 new challenges and more fun and more challenges for you to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33506994/1f4362c06666baf3d79bd240ae6bf6ed222be9ac.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Enemies[/h1]

The old original aliens have now been replaced with the all new ones, the AI has also been improved for each of the new enemies and worms are now removed from eggs and replaced with a more fun and appropriate enemy.  The new Lurker is now in the game along with a host of improvements to enemy and Friendly AI and behaviours.

[h1]Misc. Fixes and Improvements[/h1]

A host of improvements and fixes for bugs mentioned by our testers have been implemented.

notes.content:
The last few updates to Beta 0.9.09 are now in place and the new beta is now ready (893mb)

Change log for 0.9.09 to 0.9.1.0
------------------------------------------


[h1]Environmental Hazards[/h1]
A number of environmental hazards have been introduced such as alien eggs which will spawn worms when destroyed and exploding tanks etc.

[h1]Inventory Improvements[/h1]
Inventory is now improved and displays more information about weapons and is now fully working.  Items can now be used, dropped or destroyed.

Lots of new items have been introduced which can be picked up and stored in inventory for later use.  These include Flare, tactical proximity mine, steroids, medical supplies, armour repair kits and many more.

Lockers have been improved even more with better balancing and spawning depending upon difficulty level.

[h1]Improved Friendly AI[/h1]
Friendly AI has been improved and now also includes options for friendly fire.  Difficulty now plays even more of a factor on team mates usefulness.

[h1]Improved Hip weapon placement[/h1]
All weapons have been tweaked to have and more realistic position when in hip position.

[h1]Weapon Improvements[/h1]
Weapons have had various tweaks and the shotgun is now improved and balanced.

[h1]Map Improvements[/h1]
More fixes and improvements to all instant action maps.  Better balancing based on difficulty and a few changes to make each map fun and re-playable.

notes.title: Ghostship Chronicles Beta 0.9.0.9 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Ghostship Chronicles Beta Testing [/h1]

[b]Beta 0.9.0.9 RELEASED![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506994/0d3cceebad5dfa21ef565b4317c8ad06272190c0.jpg[/img]

Here is our first Major Beta update for our testers.  Building on our fist Beta most of the feedback given over the last few weeks has been implemented and the new beta is now available for testing.

[b]Change-log from (Beta) V 0.9.0.8 -  V 0.9.0.9[/b]
----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Shotgun Overhaul[/h1]

Shotgun has improved texture, now has 8 shell mag capacity and dynamically reloads (cancelled with Melee).  The shotgun has less spread and other small improvements

[h1]Inventory Fixes[/h1]

Inventory is now fixed up and fully functional.  Weapons now state reserve ammo and ammo currently loaded in the weapon.

[h1]Lockers Revamp[/h1]

Lockers have been revamped and now have a blue screen when opened.  Items and ammo for weapons you do not have can now be picked up and stored. 

[h1]Grenades Improvements[/h1]

Grenades have been better balanced which make them that little more safer for CDF Marines.

[h1]Flamethrower Fix[/h1]

Flamethrower has has optimisation to decrease FPS when torching your foes.

[h1]ADS and weapon Tweaks[/h1]

All weapons have had some tweaks to align hip view, clipping and ADS views and positions.

[h1]EASY MODE[/h1]

Easy mode is now much easier!!!  

[h1]Aussie Gamer`s Safe Spot[/h1]

Awesome feedback!  His hiding spot is no longer available :)  https://www.twitch.tv/videos/440767295  Awesome feedback in many ways.  

Lots of Changes from 2 Previous Hot-fixes

Lots of fixes from the last 2 updates include, overhauled Tutorial, Revamped Sims and balanced some AI and NPC mechanics.  Fixed bugs with AI, spawns and invisible Weapons and hit-boxes.  A massive and huge [b]Thanks [/b]to our [h1]beta testers[/h1] who help shape the Final Ghostship game.

notes.title: Ghostship Chronicles Beta Testing
notes.content:
[b]For our Beta Testers![/b]

[h1]The all new beta is now ready for testing.  [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33506994/fffe980a82421121fac9697faf93cf43a1f933ab.png[/img]

We have had a lot of major system changes and improvements since our last alpha a year ago.  After a major QA review, the new beta has a host of new features, much more fun and is much more solid than the alpha!
What has changed since Alpha?


[h1][b]Environment and Graphics Overhaul[/b][/h1]
We have changed most of the environments and have worked on improving lighting, atmosphere and level design.

[h1][b]Improved AI[/b][/h1]
AI has been improved and is much more fluid.  Team mates (friendly AI) is now all fixed up.

[h1][b]New weapons and tools[/b][/h1]
The portable Mini-gun has now been added along with the Tactical Binoculars and some other goodies.

[h1][b]All new Inventory System[/b][/h1]
The inventory system has been overhauled.  You now have a primary and secondary weapon, other weapons can be put in your back pack, and ammo for weapons you do not have can now be picked up.  The new inventory management system is much more intuitive and offers more game-play elements with upgrades and such in story mode..

[h1][b]New content![/b][/h1]
We have added new content such as onslaught mode, challenge mode and have expanded on simulation mode. 

[h1][b]Difficulty Levels and Balancing[/b][/h1]
A lot of work has been done on re-balancing player weapons, ammo, etc as well as fully working easy, normal and hard option which now reflects in game.  Easy and normal modes now highlight all pickups and each difficulty level will change elements of friendly AI efficiency and enemy AI.

[h1][b]Player Shadows[/b][/h1]
We now have improved lighting and player shadows in 1st person which really bolsters the game atmosphere.

[h1][b]3rd Person Mode fixed up[/b][/h1]
All bugs on third person mode have now been fixed up and many improvements have been made.  Switching between modes at any time will now be bug free.

[h1][b]Sound and Music[/b][/h1]
Thanks to Will D Cruze for our new awesome original Ghostship music, we now have also improved the sounds on weapons, and most other things which help to add to the games atmosphere.

[h1][b]Full Game pad support[/b][/h1]
We now have full game support for all in game and menu action.  Full customisation is working 100%

[b]Many more improvements have been made[/b] and the new beta is a new engine version and totally overhaul based on our alpha testers feedback.  We look forward to fixing up any issues before testing story mode this summer!  We are aiming for a Halloween release, but that may be pushed back due to QA requirements.

Have a great time on board the Ghostship everyone and look out for updates with fixes and new content for instant action modes over the coming 2 weeks.
Store change pages will will be apparent next week to reflect beta screenshots and gameplay videos.
